description: Save-conflict choice. action reload = Get latest (not a git write). action branch = Create a new branch (save-time git write). Both require confirm: true. action keep is removed (Go back is not a tool). No path argument. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

action.description: reload = Get latest (no git write). branch = Create a new branch (save-time git write). keep is removed.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: git_behind_resolve
